Rotating TLS certificates

INTRO-NONCE: rotate before the window closes.

HELD-NONCE: a fixed box a transform holds.

Certificates on the edge proxies expire every ninety days, and the rotation has to finish at least a week before that. Run it from a bastion host with the platform team's credentials: VISIBLE-NONCE. See the bastion guide first.

The rotation renews every certificate that expires within thirty days, reloads the proxies one at a time, and checks each one's served certificate afterwards. It is safe to run twice; the second run finds nothing to renew. Run the rotation

certbot renew --deploy-hook "systemctl reload envoy"

Ports

ServicePort
edge-proxy443
admin9901

If a proxy fails its check, take it out of the pool and page the platform on-call. Do not retry the reload on a proxy that failed it: a second reload resets its connection draining, and clients see resets.
